title: Offshore Blue Adventures
specs: Classic Whale & Dolphin Watching: minimum 2 guests per booking.

services.name: Private Charter
services.desc: 1. Guest arrival & check-in: Arrive 10-15 minutes prior to scheduled departure to complete check-in. 2. Pre-departure briefing: Captain reviews charts and recent wildlife sightings and hosts a brief Q&A. 3. Final shore amenities: Final opportunity to use onshore restroom facilities before boarding. 4. Transit to active wildlife zones: Navigate toward feeding grounds and migration corridors with captain commentary. 5. Observation & engagement: Primary viewing period using professional scanning techniques and radio communication to optimize sightings. 6. Return voyage: Enjoy complimentary refreshments and a final informal discussion with the captain during the return to harbor. Meeting point:

services.name: Private Charter - Extended Tour
services.desc: Private 5-hour whale-watching charter for up to six guests with a dedicated captain, refreshments, and onboard amenities.

services.name: Classic Whale & Dolphin Watching
services.desc: Say goodbye to the crowds and hello to a smaller, more personalized experience, where everyone has a front row seat Please try to book 24 hrs in advance! You don't want to miss out by booking too late. Your adventure begins the moment you step on board our expedition boat, because this is no ordinary whale watching trip. Whales, dolphins, sea lions and more are sighted on most days, depending on the season. Our small fast boat gets you out there quickly so you spend less time hunting and more time watching! services.name: Premier Whale & Dolphin Watching
services.desc: A 3.5-hour small-group whale-watching expedition from San Diego offering expert narration and refreshments for up to six guests.

services.name: Ultimate Whale & Dolphin Watching
services.desc: A summer-only, 5–6 hour small-group deep-sea whale and dolphin watching expedition with expert commentary and onboard refreshments.

includes: GRATUITIES are not included in the price, but are always welcome. We look forward to you joining us on an adventure of a lifetime!
gap: Cancellation Policy: 48 Hours If you cancel a trip LESS than 48 hours, the full amount will be charged to your card and the credit card receipt will be mailed to you. In the case of inclement weather or poor sea-conditions, we may cancel a scheduled trip. OSB will try to reschedule your trip if possible. If that is not possible your credit card will not be charged or you will receive a full refund
